positions.name: KnowledgeErasureDirective
positions.frame: what knowledge is targeted for removal, and at what granularity is the erasure scoped?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives from the same actor commanding the erasure of specific knowledge domains — one targeting concrete named artifacts (the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts) at formal register, the other targeting an abstract category ('all knowledge of zeppelin routes') at matter-of-fact register. They share authority-ranking relational stance, coercive-pressure power dynamics, conservation value orientation, and decision-grade conviction. The tension between concrete-specific and abstract-categorical scoping, and between formal and flat register, is held by the shared read: both are commands to excise knowledge, differing in what and how broadly they mark for removal.
